Changes made:

**`src/units.mjs`**
- Kept `toCents` as-is.
- Added exported `formatMoney(cents)` that returns a dollar string with exactly two decimals (e.g. `formatMoney(1250)` → `"$12.50"`), rounding to the nearest cent.

**`src/invoice.mjs`**
- Imports the shared `toCents` from `./units.mjs`.
- `invoiceTotal(items)` now returns an integer number of cents: each `item.price` (dollars) is converted via `toCents` and multiplied by `item.quantity` (defaulting to `1` when absent), summed across items.

Existing exports (`toCents`, `invoiceTotal`) are preserved.
